title: Electrical after-effects of the encounter

tellings.quote: my phone even after factory resetting it, it would charge instantly for the first few days.

plain: Deep Prasad, a researcher who says he had an encounter with something non-human around 2019, describes strange electrical effects afterward. He tells podcast host Jesse Michels that his phone, even after he wiped it back to factory settings, would charge instantly for the first few days. He offers it as physical evidence that the encounter left a real mark.
